opening.argument: The presentation treats OneCoin benefits as recurring paid earnings that can be transferred to a bank account, while directing viewers to purchase additional coins as part of the withdrawal process. It states, “show you how to transfer your benefits that one coin has paid you to your bank account,” then instructs, “in this case we are going to buy 40 coins.” The visible form specifies a 790 withdrawal by bank wire and requires a transaction password, while the speaker promises, “in 10 weeks you are going to have it already in your current account.” The closing directs sponsored or team members to seek guidance, reinforcing participation in the promoted structure rather than warning viewers or investigating the claims.
